reason: I already saw the settlement on TikTok and I can Google the official form myself. I am not creating an account with a startup so it can store who I am, especially when they say the listings are unverified and I still have to file on someone else's site.
objection: I don't want a startup storing my identity details, and a free account is exactly how that starts.
